summary: Iteration 136: QuoteStatusStepper Component Testing Complete - All visual stepper features verified. Universal stepper shows correctly for all quote categories (repair, fast_track, equipment, implementation). Bypassed steps show red/amber with alert icons, completed steps show green with checks, current step shows green border, pending steps show grey with numbers. Irregular badge and bypassed step popovers working correctly with justification details.

issues: React hydration warnings about span elements inside table elements (tr, tbody) - cosmetic issue from Emergent visual editor, does not affect functionality

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing quotes COT-391 (irregular), COT-390 (regular), COT-388 (fast track)
context_for_next_testing_agent: QuoteStatusStepper component fully functional. Stepper shows in Estado column for all quote categories. Visual states: completed (bg-emerald-500 + check), bypassed (bg-red-100 + alert triangle), current (border-emerald-500), pending (bg-slate-100 + number). Irregular badge opens exception history popover. Bypassed steps are clickable and show justification popover. Actions column is sticky with shadow separator.

universal_stepper_in_estado_column.description: All quote types show stepper instead of text badges
